milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate close to the emerald ore block at spawn-relative (4, 1, 6) — embedded in the western face of a stone formation — and face toward it, confirming visual identification. max_distance=5 ensures the player actively walked toward the ore (it's ~7.2 blocks from spawn), and facing_tolerance=60 confirms they are looking at it.
